pages.title: Kickstart Summer Football Camp – Register Now
pages.html:
⚽ Kickstart Summer Camp

Kickstart Summer Football Camp

Build skills, make friends, and have a blast this summer! Join us for an exciting week of football training designed for children ages 6–14.

Register Your Child Today

Why Choose Kickstart?

Expert Coaching

Led by certified football coaches with 10+ years of experience working with youth teams.

Small Group Training

Groups limited to 12 children per coach, ensuring personalized attention and rapid skill development.

Fun & Confidence

We focus on building confidence, teamwork, and a genuine love for the game in every child.

Safe Environment

All coaches are background-checked and first-aid certified. We prioritize safety at every session.

All Skill Levels Welcome

Whether your child is a beginner or an advanced player, we have a program suited to their level.

Medals & Certificates

Every camper receives a medal and certificate of achievement at the end of the week.

Camp Dates & Sessions

Kickstart Summer Football Camp runs throughout June and July. Choose the session that works best for your family:

Session 1

Dates: June 3–7, 2024

Time: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Ages: 6–9 years

Location: Central City Park, Field A

Session 2

Dates: June 10–14, 2024

Time: 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM

Ages: 10–14 years

Location: Central City Park, Field B

Session 3

Dates: June 24–28, 2024

Time: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Ages: 6–9 years

Location: Central City Park, Field A

Session 4

Dates: July 1–5, 2024

Time: 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM

Ages: 10–14 years

Location: Central City Park, Field B

Session 5

Dates: July 15–19, 2024

Time: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Ages: 6–9 years

Location: Central City Park, Field A

Session 6

Dates: July 22–26, 2024

Time: 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM

Ages: 10–14 years

Location: Central City Park, Field B

Pricing

Flexible pricing options to fit your budget:

Standard Registration

$149

Per child, per week

  • ✓ 5 days of training (3 hours/day)
  • ✓ Coaching from certified instructors
  • ✓ Medal and certificate
  • ✓ Team snack break included

Space limited to 12 children per coach.

Sibling Discount

$259

Per pair of siblings, per week

  • ✓ 5 days of training (3 hours/day) per child
  • ✓ Coaching from certified instructors
  • ✓ Medals and certificates for both
  • ✓ Team snack break included

Save $39 when registering two siblings!

Multi-Week Package

$279

Per child, for 2 weeks

  • ✓ 10 days of training (3 hours/day)
  • ✓ Coaching from certified instructors
  • ✓ Two medals and certificates
  • ✓ Team snack breaks included

Book two sessions and save $19!

What's Included?

  • Professional instruction in footwork, ball control, passing, shooting, and game tactics
  • Healthy snack and water provided each day
  • Recreational games and skill challenges
  • Friendly matches between age groups
  • End-of-week celebration with awards ceremony

Registration Form

Complete the form below to register your child. We'll send a confirmation email within 24 hours.

Parent/Guardian Information
Child Information
Select Your Session *
Health & Safety
Additional Information

* Required fields

Frequently Asked Questions

What if my child is a complete beginner?

No problem at all! Our coaches are experienced in teaching beginners. We structure sessions to accommodate all skill levels, with beginner-focused drills and patient instruction. Your child will have a fantastic time and learn fundamental skills in a supportive environment.

What should my child bring to camp?

Please ensure your child brings:

  • A water bottle (we provide water, but it's good to have your own)
  • Comfortable athletic clothing and sneakers
  • Sunscreen (we recommend applying before camp)
  • A light snack for after camp (we provide a snack during camp)
  • Optional: shin guards (recommended for added safety)
Do I need to stay with my child?

No, parents are not required to stay. Camp runs independently with coaches and staff supervision. However, you're welcome to watch from the sidelines if you'd like to see your child in action!

What happens if it rains?

We monitor the weather closely. If conditions are unsafe, we'll move activities to our covered training facility or reschedule sessions. You'll be notified by email and phone if any changes are made to the schedule.

Can my child attend multiple sessions?

Absolutely! We offer a Multi-Week Package discount if your child attends two sessions. This is a great way for them to build on their skills and make new friends.

What is your cancellation policy?

Cancellations made at least 7 days before the session begins will receive a full refund. Cancellations within 7 days of the session start date will receive a 50% refund. No refunds are issued for cancellations on or after the start date.

Is there financial assistance available?

Yes! We believe every child should have the opportunity to participate. Please contact us at info@kickstartsummer.com or (415) 555-1234 to inquire about scholarships and payment plans.

How many children are in each group?

We keep groups small with a maximum of 12 children per coach. This ensures every child gets personalized attention and can develop at their own pace.

Do you have experience with children with special needs?

Our coaches are trained to work with children of varying abilities. If your child has special needs, please contact us before registering to discuss how we can best support them. We want every child to have an amazing camp experience.

Kickstart Summer Football Camp

Email: info@kickstartsummer.com | Phone: (415) 555-1234
